connector.name: Synap Memory
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory for AI agents - log and recall conversation context over MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at synap-mcp.maximem.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.maximem, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Synap API key as a Bearer token, e.g. 'Bearer synap_...'. From https://synap.maximem.ai
